ancestry: derived from fixtures/independent-game-v2/src/game.s and the declared input schedules; frozen before Genewhip capture; no emulator output or trace recording used

video_mode.basis: Initial VDP register 1 write selects Genesis Mode 5 before display enable.
video_mode.primary_source: SEGA Genesis Software Manual, Addendum 4, section 2, compiled PDF page 18
video_mode.primary_claim: The Genesis mode is active when Register #1's bit 2=1.

play_state.basis: clear at reset; set after active-low Start

position.basis: active-low left/right updates one cell per guest play loop and clamps at both ends

marker.basis: source writes tile 2 at the byte-addressed VRAM command address 0xC280 + position * 2 bytes

title.basis: source writes ten tile-1 cells before waiting for Start; clears them after Start

sound.basis: source emits low-period, high-period, then audible-volume writes once while the action latch is clear

no_trigger.basis: all PSG writes are inside the B-press edge branch

forbidden_cartridge_storage.basis: selected ordinary linear cartridge advertises no cartridge SRAM; source references neither range

sustained_protocol.reset_policy: fresh MAME process and machine for each run
